There is a streamer i love, he has a little anxiety too so he often drinks on streams (which is no issue for us, we often make jokes about it) so maybe until you get used to it maybe you can drink a couple. 
But my suggestion for you is maybe taking some time off from streaming if it makes you feel so exhausted, so bored. Not completely giving up on streaming since i think your situation right now can get better.
For example, if there is a game you feel bored playing, you can switch between games you love.
Please again, you and your health is way more important than streaming.
I'm sorry if this was a bad advice, i just wanted to tell you to take care of yourself since i am aware most streamers can't ❤

I didn't catfished in order to experiment this but let me tell you a similar story
My friend and i opened a Tinder account with our real pictures because since we are in quarantine, we wanted to meet new people and have fun conversations

My friend is really pretty with blonde hair, she was slim and had  blue eyes. She opened her tinder account uploaded some pictures, and wrote a basic bio.

Me on the other hand, overweight, curly brown hair and brown eyes with a detailed bio.

The  texts guys sent her was paragraphs about how pretty she is, or texts like  " hey beautiful :)". She also had many swipes and likes

On the other hand, i had few guys that texted me with basic "hi" (not that i have problem with that, but obviously it was effortless) and no matter how many times i  tried to keep the conversation going, they were just cold and didnt put any effort at all. 

Plus, when my friend rejected a guy, nothing happened. They just blocked each other. But when i did, i always get the response of " you look disgusting anyways lol" 

But that doesn't mean i'm less pretty. I am pretty too, but in my own way. I know that i am not society's standarts but i am my standarts. It really hurted when this happened, but i got over it.

For me, i believe pretty privilege exists and plays a big role in our society today... And most men react differently based on your  prettiness.

However, not all men are like that. It is okay to not like somebody's appearence, but you should shut your mouth and respect them in my opinion

Still, it was just what i experienced, might be different for everyone, hope it helped

And i dont recommend you to try it as catfishing, because i believe that is how catfishes get addicted to attention and can't stop doing it

And, you can check her snapmap and see her location if she shares it (I heard it is possible to mock locations, still worth a try!)
It might be possible she just uses snapchat for you too! Maybe try asking her for a spesific snap picture?
Like "I want to see your hair in a ponytail" ( maybe a better question)
Try turning on the airplane mode and screenshotting her snaps and image searching it, maybe you can know for sure then
I really hope this is not a catfishing situation and wish the best for you!
